description: Implementation of StillnessDetector class for detecting stillness based on pose data, including methods for resetting, inputting data, calculating stillness state, and checking proximity of poses.

classes.name: StillnessDetector
classes.description: Class for detecting stillness based on pose data, using thresholds for translation and rotation, managing a FIFO queue of pose timestamps, and handling suppression deadlines.

methods.name: StillnessDetector::reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, clears FIFO, resets flags and states.

methods.name: StillnessDetector::setInput
methods.description: Adds a new pose with timestamp to the FIFO and discards old entries.

methods.name: StillnessDetector::calculate
methods.description: Calculates current stillness state based on pose proximity and suppression deadlines.

methods.name: StillnessDetector::discardOld
methods.description: Removes old pose entries outside the window duration and resets suppression deadlines if expired.

methods.name: StillnessDetector::areNear
methods.description: Checks if two poses are within proximity based on translation and rotation thresholds.
